description: Defines the GuarantorData class which encapsulates data about guarantors in a loan portfolio context, including their personal details, relationships, funding info, and linked accounts.

classes.name: GuarantorData
classes.description: Data class representing guarantor details linked to a loan, including personal, relationship, funding, and account information.

methods.name: importInstance
methods.description: Creates a GuarantorData object from imported data fields, primarily used for data import workflows.

methods.name: template
methods.description: Creates a template GuarantorData object with options for guarantor type, relationship types, and account options.

methods.name: templateOnTop
methods.description: Creates a new GuarantorData object based on an existing one, with options for overriding options for UI or form initialization.

methods.name: mergeClientData
methods.description: Merges client-specific data into an existing GuarantorData object.

methods.name: mergeStaffData
methods.description: Merges staff-specific data into an existing GuarantorData object.

methods.name: isExternalGuarantor
methods.description: Returns true if the guarantor is external based on the guarantor type.

methods.name: isExistingClient
methods.description: Returns true if the guarantor is an existing client.

methods.name: isStaffMember
methods.description: Returns true if the guarantor is a staff member.
